title: Getty Images Named Official Photographer of the 64th New York Film Festival
summary: Getty Images’ award-winning entertainment photographers will produce high-quality, trusted imagery throughout the New York Film Festival.
body_markdown:

Getty Images Named Official Photographer of the 64th New York Film Festival


Sep 21, 2026


|[PDF](https://newsroom.gettyimages.com/en/getty-images/getty-images-named-official-photographer-of-the-64th-new-york-film-festival/pdf)


**New York – September 21, 2026:**[Getty Images](https://www.gettyimages.com/) (NYSE: GETY), a preeminent global visual content creator and marketplace, has once again been named the Official Photographer of the 64th New York Film Festival (NYFF64), renewing a longstanding partnership and reinforcing Getty Images’ role as the trusted visual content partner responsible for documenting one of the longest‑running and most prestigious film festivals in the United States.


Getty Images’ award‑winning entertainment photographers will produce high‑quality, trusted imagery throughout the New York Film Festival (September 25 to October 12), presented by Film at Lincoln Center in New York City. Coverage includes red carpet premieres, official photo calls and filmmaker Q&As, often from exclusive vantage points not available elsewhere, all to be distributed exclusively through GettyImages.com.


**Getty Images’ Vice President Global Entertainment, Kirstin Benson said, "** Brands, media and talent turn to Getty Images because our photographers are trusted to capture the moments that matter most across entertainment and culture, and our world‑class distribution capabilities ensure their work reaches audiences everywhere, instantly. That trust is why Film at Lincoln Center has relied on us as its official photography partner since 2015. As the festival continues to evolve, we remain committed to documenting its legacy with the same expertise and reliability that have defined this partnership since day one."


In addition to the New York Film Festival, Getty Images covers 70,000 entertainment events annually, providing unmatched scale in capturing and distributing rights‑cleared visual content across awards, fashion, film and global cultural moments and partnering with major brands on creative content strategy.


Throughout NYFF64, filmmakers, cast members, directors, producers, screenwriters and creators participating in the festival, can access festival visuals in real time via Access by Getty Images for personal social media needs. This unique platform enables users to quickly browse, license and share high‑quality, accurate, rights cleared content instantly, giving talent and industry professionals greater control over how they appear on social media in real time. Visit[https://access.greenfly.site/](https://access.greenfly.site/?utm_medium=press_release&utm_campaign=access) for more.


*Image credit above: Cindy Ord/Getty Images*
